In Shan State and the Bago Region, Russians are on the front lines, conducting training missions and occasionally providing operational support. The Myanmar military has adopted low-cost suicide drones similar to those Russia has tested in Ukraine.
As the powerful Arakan Army has done with its affiliate groups, the Karenni State resistance wants to create a united army by April. In southern Shan State, it has already brought together myriad local forces under a single command, Alpha.
After establishing a new political platform in which the more powerful ethnic armed forces are most prominent, the Burmese resistance is now focusing on intelligence. Covert operations have shifted to building networks of informants and a joint intelligence framework is being set up.
Bangladesh, China, India and the Burmese opposition are all courting ethnic militia chief Twan Mrat Naing, whose army is fighting the ruling junta in Arakan State. These parties each have a stake in this region in western Myanmar and are seeking to cover their backs as the fate of state's city of Sittwe, under attack from the Arakan Army, remains uncertain.
Despite Myanmar's ongoing civil war, Rohingya refugees are starting to return to Rakhine State from crowded camps in Bangladesh. China's Ministry of State Security and the People's Liberation Army appear to be orchestrating the final stage of a plan to secure the CCP's vital Indian Ocean interests.
European mercenaries in Myanmar, part 1/4 – On 27 October 2023, twelve foreigners were captured by an ethnic rebel group near Laukkai in northern Myanmar. Most of these men were former French legionnaires, but two were still on active duty.
